title: Tracing the Journey of a Library Book
transcript: When a large library lends the same books through several branches, a copy may spend weeks travelling from one shelf to another. A team studying this network began at the sorting depot, where books were already scanned on arrival. The team added a second scan when each crate left the depot. To make the comparison fair, they used only novels, since specialist textbooks often follow a separate delivery schedule. They also recorded the number of requests waiting at each destination. The longest delays happened just after the weekend, but the main cause was not heavy road traffic. Monday crates often remained at the depot until they were full, even if a reader had already requested a book inside. After the depot began sending partly filled crates, readers received books sooner. The manager now wants to check whether the improvement justifies the additional fuel used for deliveries.

questions.prompt: The study began at the sorting ____.
questions.explanation: 研究首先在分拣站进行，那里已有到货扫描。

questions.prompt: A second scan took place when each ____ was sent out.
questions.explanation: 新增的第二次扫描在每个运输箱离开分拣站时进行。

questions.prompt: For a fair comparison, the team limited the study to ____.
questions.explanation: 研究仅比较小说，因为专业教材可能采用另一套配送安排。

questions.prompt: What caused most of the delays just after the weekend?
options: Books waited for containers to fill up.
questions.answer: Books waited for containers to fill up.
questions.explanation: 周一的运输箱经常在装满前不发货，书因此留在分拣站。

questions.prompt: What is the manager's next concern?
options: The extra fuel used for quicker deliveries
The accuracy of the arrival scans
questions.answer: The extra fuel used for quicker deliveries
questions.explanation: 经理想知道送达速度的改善能否抵得上额外油耗。
